Pakistan's short-term inflation rose to 12.31 per cent year-on-year driven largely by expensive LPG and perishable food items.

Short-term inflation rose to 12.31pc year-on-year in the week ending Nov 5, driven by LPG and perishable food products, according to Pakistan Bureau of Statistics data. Out of 51 essential items, 21 increased in price while 10 declined, keeping short-term inflation in the double digits.
